# Question 1: Estimateurs Non Paramétriques

```{r}

alpha <- 10 # parameter for h_n
h_n <- function(x) {
  return((1/x^alpha))
}

seq_h <- sapply(seq(1, N, 1), h_n)

g <- function(x){
  return(print("waiting for g"))

K_gaussian <- function(x) {
  return(pnorm(x))
}

K_epach <- function(x) {
  return(ifelse(abs(x) <= 1, (3/4)*(1-x^2), 0))
}

K_quadra <- function(x) {
  return(ifelse(abs(x) <= 1,

}
```
